sub_strands.name: Integration Techniques and Systems
performance_indicators: Evaluate complex integrals using integration by parts, substitution, and partial fractions.
Formulate and solve first-order ordinary differential equations ($ODEs$) with separable variables for growth models.
Apply numerical methods, including Simpson's rule, to estimate definite integrals of non-analytical functions.

sub_strands.name: Matrix Transformations and Systems
performance_indicators: Compute the determinant and inverse of a $3 	imes 3$ matrix using cofactor matrices.
Solve simultaneous linear equations in three variables using Cramer's rule and Gaussian elimination.
Determine eigenvalues and eigenvectors for basic $2 	imes 2$ linear transformation matrices.

sub_strands.name: Entropy, Free Energy, and Transition Metals
performance_indicators: Calculate entropy changes and Gibbs free energy changes to predict chemical spontaneity.
Explain the electronic configurations, variable oxidation states, and catalytic properties of d-block transition elements.
Deduce shapes and coordinate bonding configurations of transition metal complex ions.

sub_strands.name: Structural Elucidation Techniques
performance_indicators: Interpret Infrared (IR) spectra to identify functional groups present in organic structures.
Analyze mass spectrometry fragmentation patterns to determine the molecular weight of unknown compounds.

sub_strands.name: Interference, Diffraction, and Quantum Models
performance_indicators: Analyze double-slit interference patterns using wave equations.
Explain the photoelectric effect and calculate work functions using Einstein's photoelectric equation.
Solve problems involving de Broglie wavelength thresholds and wave-particle duality concepts.

sub_strands.name: Radioactivity, Fission, and Fusion
performance_indicators: Formulate balanced nuclear equations representing alpha, beta, and gamma radioactive decay loops.
Calculate nuclear binding energy deficits and energy release yields during fission and fusion events.
Determine radioactive half-life constants using exponential decay functions.

sub_strands.name: DNA Replication, Protein Synthesis, and Inheritance
performance_indicators: Explain the molecular mechanisms of semi-conservative DNA replication and transcription.
Translate mRNA codon sequences into specific amino acid chains using the genetic code matrix.
Solve genetic problems involving monohybrid, dihybrid, codominance, and sex-linked inheritance patterns.

sub_strands.name: Natural Selection and Recombinant DNA
performance_indicators: Evaluate evolutionary evidence from comparative anatomy, embryology, and fossil records.
Outline the production workflow of genetically modified organisms using restriction enzymes and plasmids.

sub_strands.name: Linear Data Structures and Search/Sort Logics
performance_indicators: Implement stacks, queues, and linked lists, managing memory address tracking efficiently.
Analyze the time and space complexity of binary search and bubble/quick sort routines.
Construct recursive functions to solve algorithmic traversal challenges.

sub_strands.name: Normalization and SQL Operations
performance_indicators: Normalize flat data models up to Third Normal Form (3NF) to minimize redundancy.
Write multi-table SQL queries utilizing inner/outer joins, subqueries, and grouping metrics.

sub_strands.name: Project Proposals and Systematic Reviews
performance_indicators: Draft rigorous project engineering proposals including budget layouts and scope matrices.
Synthesize cross-domain research papers to write structural literature reviews.

strands.name: Uandishi wa Kitaaluma na Makala ya Kisayansi

sub_strands.name: Tathmini na Tasnifu za Kiufundi
performance_indicators: Kuandika tasnifu za kisayansi zilizokamilika na zenye kufuata kanuni za kunukuu vyanzo.
Kutathmini makala ya kiufundi na kutoa hoja kwa mtindo wa kijadili na kimantiki.
